titles.title: GHOST Act
GHOST Act
Guaranteeing Honest Ownership in Secondary Ticketing Act
A bill to prohibit the speculative sale of event tickets, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

bill.summary:
Guaranteeing Honest Ownership in Secondary Ticketing Act
This bill prohibits event ticket resellers from selling, offering for sale, or advertising for sale an event ticket unless the reseller has actual possession of the ticket. Actual possession includes physical or virtual possession of an event ticket issued by a ticket issuer.
The bill provides for enforcement by the Federal Trade Commission and state attorneys general.
